{"PROG_ID": "select_measure", "QUERY_ID": "FP\Common\Measure", "QUERY_SEQ": "0", "INST_SEQ": "0", "QUERY_VALUE": "---Service Parameter : 0USER_ID
---Service Parameter : 1MENU_ID
---Check client parameter : USER_ID
---FOUND USER_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : MENU_ID
---FOUND MENU_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service

    	 WITH M_TABLE AS (
					   		SELECT SEGMENT1     AS USER_ID  			
									, SEGMENT2     AS MENU_ID  			
									, SEGMENT3     AS MEA_ID 		  	         													
									, SEGMENT4     AS MEA_NAME													
									, SEGMENT5     AS MEA_VALUE          
									, ATTRIBUTE1   AS TYPE                   
									, ATTRIBUTE2   AS FLAG               
									, ATTRIBUTE3   AS ACTIVE_FLAG       
					     	FROM   	SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
						    WHERE  	A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'UI_AMEND_MEASURE'
						    AND     A.SEGMENT2 = @MENU_ID
						    AND 	A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			   )
			 SELECT * FROM (SELECT   ISNULL(A.MEA_ID, B.MEA_ID) MEA_ID
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_NAME, A.MEA_NAME) MEA_NAME
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_VALUE, A.MEA_VALUE) MEA_VALUE
						,ISNULL(B.TYPE, A.TYPE) TYPE
						,ISNULL(B.FLAG, A.FLAG) FLAG
						,A.MENU_ID
						,@USER_ID AS USER_ID
			FROM   M_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			    SELECT *
			    FROM   TH_UIS_USER_AMEND_MEA_RELATE B WITH(NOLOCK)
			    WHERE  USER_ID = @USER_ID
			    AND    MENU_ID = @MENU_ID
			    AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			) B
			ON    A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID
			AND   A.MEA_ID  = B.MEA_ID
			AND   A.TYPE 	= B.TYPE
			WHERE 1=1
			AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') B
GROUP BY MEA_ID, MEA_NAME, MEA_VALUE, TYPE, FLAG, MENU_ID, USER_ID
    
      ", "JOB_TYPE": "read", "START_TIME": "2026-11-12 21:50:34", "END_TIME": "2026-11-12 21:50:34", "INSERT_ID": "jaeuk.shin", "LOG_TYPE": "SQL", "IP_ADDRESS": "100.113.200.36", "SESSION_ID": "20261112215034_309", "PARAM_VALUE": "{USER_ID : jaeuk.shin MENU_ID : FP00595_Amend }", "DUR_TIME": "4", "ATTRIBUTE1": "GeneralExecuteQuery", "ATTRIBUTE2": "", "ATTRIBUTE3": "", "ATTRIBUTE4": "", "ATTRIBUTE5": ""}

     , A.MODEL_ID, A.VALUE, A.APPLY_DATE
     , A.VERSION
FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT DISTINCT A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS E_CATEGORY
	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ITEM_CONV_CALC'
	AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
) D
ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY

	SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION

    						, 'Pancake (m/batch)'
    						, 'cell/batch'
    						, 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
    						, 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
	GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
) E
